run_match_mnist_train_set: run the Hungarian algorithm to match MNIST training images to QMNIST training images by digit
run_read_idx3_ubyte: read an IDX3 unsigned byte image file (plain, gzipped, or xz compressed) into a PyTorch tensor
run_read_idx2_int: read an IDX2 integer label file (plain, gzipped, or xz compressed) into a PyTorch tensor
run_squared_jittered_distances: compute pairwise squared Euclidean distances between two image sets with spatial jitter tolerance
run_save_2dtensor: save a 2D PyTorch tensor to a text file in .MAT format with dimensions and values
